reviews.text: The powder clumped instantly and left a chalky aftertaste no matter how long I shook it.
The vanilla flavor tasted artificial and made my smoothie smell like chemicals.
It upset my stomach every time I drank it after a workout.
The scoop was buried at the bottom and the bag would not reseal properly.
The label promised smooth mixing, but it left gritty chunks in cold water.
The tub arrived half open with powder dust all over the shipping box.
